🏈For the first time in 100 years on Thanksgiving, three games were decided by five or fewer points. The last time that happened was November 25, 1926, when there were 0-0 ties between the Chicago Cardinals-Chicago Bears and Akron Pros-Canton Bulldogs, and a 9-6 win by the Los Angeles Buccaneers over the Detroit Panthers. 
🏈The average margin of victory of 2.7 points is the lowest ever on Thanksgiving, with a minimum three games played.
